text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day while walking through town,
I spotted Transcend and Buena Vista.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Man, thanks a bunch! Shopping for imported goods is so much fun with all the rare finds.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I figured it was just the kind of shop you'd like, Tran-san.
Oh, since we came all the way out here—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't we check out a fancy cafe?"
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I figured you'd say that, so I scoped out a cafe already♪ Wouldn't feel right making you pick all the spots.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Oh, you didn't have to! I must repay the favor somehow—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, nah nah, it's totally fine.
Don't worry about it at all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hah?! Did I forget to measure the dressing?!
Ah geez... calorie counting is seriously such a pain...!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: For our dear Jordan-chan, here you go!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The latest diet app~! Just snap a pic and it calculates the calories instantly♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just take a pic?! For real? That's insane!
With this, staying on track is gonna be a breeze~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between the other day and now, Transcend's attentiveness and sharp observational skills toward her friends are truly impressive.
It's something worth learning from.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, what a pickle.
Whatever should I do, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: What's up, Acu-san... Wait, now that is an old handheld console.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A lovely fan gave it to me~.
But for some reason, it won't let me play.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
When that happens, check the batteries—!
...Ah, they're already in.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe the cartridge itself isn't—!
...Nope, that's inserted too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Seems it's tricky after all, dear...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Accu-san, can I borrow that for a bit?
I kinda wanna tinker with it, y'know?
choice_data_list: (It seems complicated, though... what will she do?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, upon stopping by the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear me, defeated again~
Games sure are tricky things, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That it did. Tran-san said it suddenly started working again.
Turns out it still had plenty of fight left in it~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer-chan.
What's up?
choice_data_list: How did you fix that console?
How did you fix that console?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you hear from Accu-san?
It just fixed itself magically~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, who am I kidding, you know better than that.
I just gave it a standard repair job.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Tracked down the issue, gathered the parts.
Plus, having an acquaintance teach me the fix was pretty lucky, I'd say.
choice_data_list: That's still plenty impressive, you know.
That's still plenty impressive, you know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't worry about it.
Ah, but keep it a secret from Accu-san, alright?
Don't want her feeling all indebted to me.
choice_data_list: You really are a sweet girl.
You really are a sweet girl.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't worry about it.
Ah, but keep it a secret from Accu-san, alright?
Don't want her feeling all indebted to me.
choice_data_list: You really are a sweet girl.
You really are a sweet girl.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, much obliged.
Look at you, being so thoughtful!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: 'Look who's talking,' I couldn't help but think to myself.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, hold on, that's bad for business,
Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to be a dangerous info broker lurking in the shadows.
Don't go forgetting that now, okay?
